svg.aria-label: Sync pipeline: scan, preflight, fetch, integrate, record. Integrate fast-forwards only when safe and keeps local changes; otherwise the repo is left as is with a recorded reason.
svg.text: HOW ONE REPO IS SYNCED · ON A WORKER POOL, MANY AT ONCE
no local commits; local changes are stashed
and put back. Other branches move too.
